title: Qyrix
features:
Clear Dungeons in 2 minutes!

Warning: you may in counter bugs and errors. Working hard to fix them!

Supported executors:
- Wave
- Seliwear
- Delta

-- Combat --

Kill Aura – Automatically damages nearby enemies.

Autofarm – Automatically finds and kills enemies.

Farm Methods – Rage (TP farming) / Legit (pathfinding) (under construction).

Boss Handling – Special logic for bosses (Akuma, Infested Beast, Atticus, The Damned).

Akuma Safety – Keeps player 15 studs away from Akuma.

Auto Collect Breakables – Instantly destroys breakable objects.

Auto Upgrade – Automatically selects upgrades.

NoClip – Walk through walls and obstacles.

FailSafe System – Prevents softlocks and cutscene issues.


-- Legit --

Hitbox Expander – Enlarges enemy hitboxes.

Adjustable Hitbox Size – Slider to control size.

Show Hitbox – Visualizes expanded hitboxes.


-- Quest --

Auto Claim Quests – Automatically claims daily quests.

Auto Claim Achievements – Automatically claims achievements.
